newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones leaps to second biggest daily gains ever.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones leaps to second biggest daily gains ever.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average racked up its second biggest one-day gain ever Tuesday, propelled by positive news on retail inflation.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones ended with a gain of 135.26 points, or 2.10 percent, at 6,587.16 -- the next best gain after soaring 187 points on Oct. 21, 1987, two days after the "Black Monday" stock market crash. In the broader market, advancing issues beat declines 18-4 on active volume of 508 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
